answer.origin: Yahoo Finance article dated 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s announcement in late June 2026; the original announcement day is not given.
answer.note: Supply-side lead for NVIDIA AI rack liquid cooling in Asia. Per the Yahoo Finance report (2026-07-01) of NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement, NN is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant to produce liquid cooling for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and says 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. NN targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. These are NN's own statements, not NVIDIA disclosures. Conditional interpretation: if the pre-sold awards are confirmed, third-party thermal supply for NVIDIA-rack hardware in China/Asia is being expanded, which would support the depth of NVIDIA's rack supply chain. The source does not show NVIDIA as a direct buyer, does not give any NVIDIA purchase amount, and does not establish NVIDIA orders or revenue, so no such inference is drawn. The NN revenue and earnings projections (narrative and unnamed analysts) concern NN, not NVIDIA, and are not used for NVIDIA. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is unrelated to NVIDIA supply or demand.
limitations: The pre-sold status and multi-year, multi-product awards are NN's self-reported statement; no contract terms, award values, or customer names are disclosed.
The source does not confirm NVIDIA as the buyer or end customer of the new capacity; the NVIDIA link rests on NN's description of NVIDIA AI data center racks.
The US$80-90 million 2026 figure is NN's forward business target, not a reported result, and its split between NVIDIA-linked and other business is unknown.
The original announcement day is not supplied; only the Yahoo Finance publication date of 2026-07-01 is known.
The NN revenue and earnings projections are third-party or unnamed-analyst figures for NN and say nothing about NVIDIA's revenue, orders, or margins.
The reason for the Russell Microcap Value Index removal and its relevance to NVIDIA are not established by the source.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original press release or SEC filing for the late-June 2026 announcement to confirm its date and the exact wording of the pre-sold and US$80-90 million claims.
Check NN's next quarterly filing for data center liquid cooling revenue, backlog, and customer concentration, to test whether the 2026 target is being met.
Check NVIDIA's public supplier disclosures or rack-level partner announcements to see whether NVIDIA names NN or other liquid cooling vendors in its AI rack supply chain.
Compare with other NVIDIA rack cooling suppliers' Asia capacity announcements to corroborate the build-out before relying on the supply lead.
